title: Booking Window, Length of Stay and Rooms per Stay — Room Reservations Rate Plans
content:
Every Room Reservations rate plan is loaded with a booking window, measured in calendar days between the booking date and the arrival date, a length-of-stay range in nights, and a ceiling on the reservations one guest may hold under the plan at the same hotel for overlapping nights.

| Rate plan | Minimum days between booking and arrival | Maximum days between booking and arrival | Minimum nights per reservation | Maximum nights per reservation | Maximum rooms per stay |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Advance Purchase Non-Refundable Rate | 7 | 350 | 1 | 21 | 9 |
| Semi-Flexible Saver Rate | 3 | 350 | 1 | 21 | 9 |
| Flexible Rate | 0 | 350 | 1 | 30 | 9 |
| Member Flexible Rate | 0 | 350 | 1 | 30 | 9 |
| Bed & Breakfast Package Rate | 0 | 350 | 1 | 14 | 9 |
| Corporate Negotiated Rate | 0 | 350 | 1 | 30 | 9 |
| Group Block Rate | 0 | 350 | 1 | 30 | 9 |
| Reward Night Rate | 0 | 350 | 1 | 30 | 4 |

## Definitions

- **Minimum and maximum days** are calendar days between the booking date and the arrival date.
- **Minimum and maximum nights** are the nights per reservation.
- **Maximum rooms per stay** is the largest number of reservations one guest may hold under the plan at the same hotel for overlapping nights.

## Reading the limits

- A minimum of 0 days means the plan may be booked for arrival on the booking date itself; only the Advance Purchase Non-Refundable Rate (7 days) and the Semi-Flexible Saver Rate (3 days) require booking ahead.
- The longest stay on one reservation is 30 nights (Flexible, Member Flexible, Corporate Negotiated, Group Block and Reward Night Rates); the Advance Purchase Non-Refundable and Semi-Flexible Saver Rates stop at 21 nights and the Bed & Breakfast Package Rate at 14 nights.
- Every plan admits 9 rooms per stay except the Reward Night Rate, which admits 4.
- Every plan can be booked up to 350 days ahead, and every plan requires at least 1 night.
